parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass. It forms the front face of the display and is flat and smooth.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from the device, allowing users to view images, videos, or data.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed in place and does not move relative to the rest of the display.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and provides stability.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the display upright and may allow for limited tilt or rotation depending on design.
parts.Movement_description: The base is typically stationary, though it may allow the upper part of the display to pivot or tilt slightly.
